subject: Partner Academy: Aurora Consulting certification track & kickoff
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Clara Mendez <clara@aurora-consulting.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Partner Academy: Aurora Consulting certification track & kickoff

Hi Clara —

Great to meet at the conference last month. As discussed, wed love to run a tailored Partner Academy for Aurora Consulting to certify your delivery teams on Redwood Inference best practices (serving runtime, deployment patterns, SLAs, and the Optimize toolkit).

Quick ask: can you confirm the target audience (number of engineers, solution architects, and PMs) and any preferred weeks in June/July? Ive attached a one-page syllabus to start.

Proposed outcomes:
- 6-week certification track (hands-on labs + eval)
- Two instructor-led sessions per week (recorded)
- Certified badge for engineers who pass the capstone eval

Im looping in Marissa (partner ops) and Sergio (partnerships) to scope logistics and pricing.

Thanks —

Mina Haddad
Head of Partner Enablement
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment: Aurora_Onboarding_Syllabus.pdf (1 page)
From: Clara Mendez <clara@aurora-consulting.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Academy: Aurora Consulting certification track & kickoff

Thanks, Mina — this looks promising.

Audience: 8 people total — 5 platform/infra engineers, 2 solutions architects, 1 product manager. Were targeting July for formal rollout. Two clarifying items:
1) Are there different certification tiers (e.g., Associate / Professional)?
2) We have a compliance week the first week of July; would you be able to push the kickoff to the week of July 12 if needed?

Also, can you share the hands-on lab environment requirements? Our infra team needs to validate capacity.

Best,

Clara Mendez
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Aurora Consulting
clara@aurora-consulting.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Partner Academy: Aurora Consulting certification track & kickoff

Looping in Dev for lab infra and cost estimate. Quick notes:
- Certification tiers: we typically run two tracks: Foundation (2-week, overview + basics) and Professional (6-week, labs + capstone). Recommend Aurora go straight to Professional given audience makeup.
- Pricing: partner discounted cohort price is attached in the Partner_Playbook_v1.pptx (slide 6). We can offer a 15% first-cohort discount for strategic partners.
- Lab env: Dev, can you confirm whether the hosted sandboxes we use for partner labs will support a 4-GPU ephemeral cluster for peak exercises? If not, list alternatives.

Marissa
Partner Programs Manager
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Partner_Playbook_v1.pptx (pptx, 28 slides)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Clara Mendez <clara@aurora-consulting.com>, Ben Rowe <ben.rowe@aurora.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Partner Academy: Aurora Consulting certification track & kickoff

Hi Clara / Ben —

Thanks for the quick reply and the headcount. Based on your audience and the internal recs, heres our proposed plan for the Professional track (6 weeks):

Week 0 (prep): access + baseline assessment
Weeks 1-4 (core): two 90-min instructor sessions/week; dedicated hands-on lab each week (self-paced exercises + instructor hours)
Week 5 (capstone): 1 full-day workshop (team demo + runtime tuning exercises)
Week 6 (eval & graduation): proctored exam + badge issuance

We can shift kickoff to the week of July 12 — that works for us. Lab environment: Dev confirmed we can provision ephemeral 4xA10G/4xA100 class nodes for the capstone windows; will provide a pre-provisioning checklist.

Attachments included: Aurora_Onboarding_Syllabus.pdf, Partner_Playbook_v1.pptx, Week1-Labs.zip (lab exercises and sample data). Also shared a Drive folder with starter templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-aurora-academy.

Next steps:
- Clara: confirm final participant list + preferred timezone for sessions (we suggest two session times to accommodate EMEA/US overlap)
- Ben: let us know if you want an extra compliance-focused module covering Private deployment patterns and audit logging (SOC2 evidence flow).

Thanks — looking forward to running this with Aurora.

Mina Haddad
Head of Partner Enablement
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Attachment: Week1-Labs.zip (contains lab guides and dockerfiles)
From: Ben Rowe <ben.rowe@aurora.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Clara Mendez <clara@aurora-consulting.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Academy: Aurora Consulting certification track & kickoff

All good on our side. Well confirm the participant roster by Monday, June 7, and prefer the 10am PT / 5pm CET session cadence for core workshops.

Wed like that extra compliance module — can we add a 90-minute session in Week 3 focused on Private deployment (VPC/on-prem checklist, KMS/HSM integration, audit log exports)? If there are additional charges, please call them out.

Thanks —
Ben
Head of Delivery, Aurora Consulting
ben.rowe@aurora.com
